text:
Hochwohlgebohrner Herr,
Insonders hochzuverehrender Herr Krieges und Forstrath
Den so eben vom Herrn Podprefecten o Brzechsta
durch den Advocaten v Wieckowski erhaltenen
Brief geben ich mir die Ehre Ew HochWohlgebohren
in der Anlage gehorsamst zu communiciren, und
daraus werden Hochdieselben zu ergehen belieben,
daß H. Brzechsta seiner Geschäfte wegen
erst den 15ten d. m. von Warschau abzureisen
gedenkt, auch daß gute Aussicht in Ansehung der Trąbczyner
Herrschaft vorhanden, dieses habe ich für hochwohlgeb.
nen mittheilen und zugleich versichern wollen
daß ich nie aufheren werde mich zu nennen
Ew Hochwohlgebohren
Kalisz
den 8ten Martz 12.
gehorsamster Diener
der Kreis Rath
Thiel
ad 12. Merz 1812.

translation.en:
Right Honourable Sir, most particularly to be revered Councillor of War and Forests! The letter just now received from the sub-prefect o Brzechsta by way of the advocate von Wieckowski I take the honour of communicating to Your Right Honourable, most obediently, in the enclosure, and from it you will be pleased to gather [uncertain: to gather] that Mr Brzechsta, on account of his business, does not intend to depart from Warsaw until the 15th of this month, and also that there is good prospect with respect to the lordship of Trąbczyn; this I wished to impart to Your Right Honourable and at the same time to assure you that I shall never cease to call myself Your Right Honourable's

Kalisz

the 8th of March 12.

most obedient servant

the district councillor

Thiel

received 12 March 1812.

text_english:
Right Honourable Sir, most particularly to be revered Councillor of War and Forests! The letter just now received from the sub-prefect o Brzechsta by way of the advocate von Wieckowski I take the honour of communicating to Your Right Honourable, most obediently, in the enclosure, and from it you will be pleased to gather [uncertain: to gather] that Mr Brzechsta, on account of his business, does not intend to depart from Warsaw until the 15th of this month, and also that there is good prospect with respect to the lordship of Trąbczyn; this I wished to impart to Your Right Honourable and at the same time to assure you that I shall never cease to call myself Your Right Honourable's

Kalisz

the 8th of March 12.

most obedient servant

the district councillor

Thiel

received 12 March 1812.
summary_en: District Councillor Thiel forwards to Triebenfeld an enclosed letter from Sub-prefect Herr v. Brzechsta, received via the advocate v. Wieckowski, reporting that Brzechsta's business will keep him in Warsaw until the 15th of the month, and that prospects concerning the Trąbczyner lordship are good. Written from Kalisz, with a note of receipt on 12 March 1812; otherwise consisting largely of formal assurances of service.
summary_de: Übersendet in der Anlage ein durch den Advocaten v. Wieckowski überbrachtes Schreiben des Sub-präfecten v. Brzechsta, aus dem hervorgeht, daß dieser seiner Geschäfte wegen erst am 15. des Monats aus Warschau abzureisen beabsichtigt; hinsichtlich der Herrschaft Trąbczyn bestehe gute Aussicht. Der District-Rath Thiel versichert dem Kriegs- und Forstrath von Triebenfeld seine Ergebenheit; Vermerk des Empfangs zum 12. März 1812.
